reply:
The AI Travel Planner validates coordinates at render time rather than in the Zod schema because `streamObject` validates the entire object at once. If strict latitude and longitude bounds were enforced inside the Zod schema, a single bad coordinate from the model would reject the entire itinerary, resulting in an empty screen. 

Filtering the coordinates during render in `ItineraryView` keeps any failures local—meaning a bad number results in a missing pin rather than crashing the whole response.

(Sources: resume, AI Travel Planner README)

steps.summary: coordinates validate render time zod schema in ai-travel-planner
